test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.

The pink locusts are attacking the crops in several districts of Rajasthan.

options.text: The crops in several districts of Rajasthan have been attacked by the pink locusts.
The pink locusts in several districts of Rajasthan are being attacked by the crops.
The crops in several districts of Rajasthan are being attacked by the pink locusts.
Several districts of Rajasthan are being attacked in the crops by the pink locusts.

solution:
The correct answer is **'The crops in several districts of Rajasthan are being attacked by the pink locusts.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Whenever we convert into **the present continuous passive form**, we need to **follow the rule.**
 
• **Rule = Object + is/am/are + being + verb 3rd form + by + subject.**
 
 
• In the given sentence **the object is **- The pink locusts.
 
• **The verb **- 'are attacking' will be converted into 'are being attacked'.
 
• **the subject is **- the crops in several districts of Rajasthan.
 
 
 
• Now **the sentence in passive form **would be - *The crops in several districts of Rajasthan are being attacked by the pink locusts.*

Hence, the answer is **option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**Let's **understand the concept **with **some more examples.**

 
• The cops are saving the life of a boy.
 
 
• *The life of a boy is being saved by the cops.*
 
 
 
• The students are reading the books.
 
 
• *The books are being read by the students.*
